
---

### Install
1. Download the `.apk` below on your Android phone and open it.
2. Allow **Install unknown apps** when asked. If Play Protect warns about an unknown developer, tap **Install anyway**.
3. If installing over an older version fails, uninstall the old version first.

Requires Android 10 or newer. Full details in the [README](https://github.com/jemishmayani/Anamorphic-Desqueeze#readme).
